生輔組急難慰助專區申請須知: Student Assistance Section: Emergency Financial Aid Application Guidelines
從教務處歷年課程表找到「動遊系」，先核對入學年與一般班、技優班。把自己的那一份存: Find 'Department of Animation and Game Design' in the Office of Academic Affairs curriculum catalog across academic years, and check your enrollment year as well as regular class or skills-excellence class (技優班). Save your copy to reference later during course selection and graduation audits.
把系統未通過的項目分成課程、英文、證照、實習與專題，註明缺哪一項。零學分必修也一: Categorize unpassed items in the system into courses, English, certifications, internships, and capstone project, noting exactly what is missing. Check zero-credit required courses as well; do not look only at whether total credits are sufficient.
找系辦時一起帶入學年課表、成績與未通過項目的畫面，直接問缺課要補哪門、已有證明如: When visiting the department office, bring your enrollment year curriculum, grades, and screenshots of unpassed items. Ask directly which course to take to make up for missing credits and how existing certificates can be recognized. If credit transfer or student status are involved, ask the Registration and Curriculum Division for assistance.
先向系辦說明自己的入學年、班別與預計實習期間，索取適用的辦法及申請表。也一起問時: First inform the department office of your enrollment year, class section, and expected internship period to obtain the applicable regulations and application forms. Also ask how hours are calculated and what must be submitted upon completion, rather than only knowing the minimum required hours.
把公司名稱、職務說明、預計做的事與工作期間整理給系辦或指導老師看。自找公司或原本: Organize the company name, job description, planned tasks, and work period for the department office or your advisor to review. Confirm in advance whether self-found companies or existing part-time jobs can be recognized; do not wait until completion to ask.
請實習承辦確認合約由誰簽、保險何時生效，以及出了問題要找誰。拿到需補文件的清單後: Ask the internship coordinator to confirm who signs the contract, when insurance takes effect, and whom to contact if problems arise. Set the start date only after receiving the checklist of required supplementary documents; never treat a company's verbal agreement as completed school procedures.
把證照全名、發照單位與預計考取版本交給系辦，問是否適用自己的入學年與班別。先確認: Submit the full certification title, issuing agency, and planned exam version to the department office to verify if it applies to your enrollment year and class section. Confirm it is eligible for recognition before arranging registration and payment; do not simply take a test because others passed it.
準備清楚的證照或成績證明，先核對姓名、證照名稱與生效日期。再向系辦確認登錄位置、: Prepare clear copies of your certificate or score transcript, checking your name, certificate title, and effective date first. Then confirm with the department office where to register it, whether additional documents are needed, and when the result will appear in the graduation audit.
先向職發中心確認當期獎助資格，並檢查本人匯款帳戶資料是否已交出納組。若老師已團體: First check with the Career Development Center regarding current reward eligibility and ensure your remittance account details have been submitted to the Cashier Section. Even if an instructor registered the certification as a group, still confirm whether an additional reward application is required.
先整理不能到課的日期、節次與原因，再向導師或生輔組確認假別及證明。遇到考試、心理: Organize the dates, class periods, and reasons for your absence, then verify the leave category and required proof with your class advisor or the Student Assistance Section. For exam periods, mental health leave, or extended absences, ask clearly in advance whether additional procedures apply.
從學校「在校學生」入口進入請假服務，依系統填寫資料並確認是否送出。若找不到操作項: Log into the leave application service via the school's 'Current Students' portal, fill in the details in the system, and confirm submission. If you cannot find the required option, bring your screen to consult your advisor or the Student Assistance Section; do not assume notifying someone via messaging apps completes the process.
送件後回到系統查看是否核准；沒有回覆時，主動找導師追蹤。若會影響考試或需請長假，: After submitting, return to the system to verify whether it has been approved; if there is no response, follow up proactively with your advisor. If it affects exams or involves extended leave, consult your advisor and the Registration and Curriculum Division for follow-up steps; do not mistake submission for approval.
把入學年課表與本學期系統課表並排，先看必修是否漏選，再檢查學分與衝堂。若有抵免、: Place your enrollment year curriculum and this semester's system schedule side by side. Check first for any missed required courses, then verify total credits and timetable conflicts. If you have credit transfers, retaken courses, or makeup courses, list them separately and consult the department office before course selection.
到教務處確認現在屬於初選、加退選還是棄選，再依該階段公告辦理。過去的加退選日期不: Check with the Office of Academic Affairs whether the current period is preliminary registration, add/drop, or course withdrawal, and follow that stage's announcement. Past add/drop dates cannot be reused; if past deadlines or facing special circumstances, consult the Registration and Curriculum Division first.
操作後重新開啟系統課表，確認課名、班別與時間真的正確。若和預期不同，記下課程代碼: After making changes, reopen your system schedule to verify that course titles, class sections, and times are indeed correct. If anything differs from expected, note the course code, take a screenshot of the issue, and contact the Registration and Curriculum Division; attending class or receiving instructor consent cannot substitute for official system records.
先說明自己是新生、轉學生、轉系生或其他身分，帶原修課程與成績資料詢問。請承辦確認: First state your status—whether a freshman, transfer student, major change student, or other status—and bring your previous course descriptions and transcript for inquiry. Ask the coordinator to confirm whether applications are currently accepted and what rules apply; do not assume courses are eligible for waiver simply because course titles look similar.
在可申請的期間填寫抵免系統並列印表格，備妥原校成績證明正本。依公告送開課單位與就: Within the application window, fill out the credit waiver system, print the form, and prepare the original transcript from your former school. Submit it to the course-offering department and your enrolled department for sign-off as announced, then hand it to the Division of Registrar and Curriculum for final review; do not stop at online entry alone.
先查已核准抵免的科目，再問是否仍需自行調整本學期課表。若結果和申請內容不同，拿申: Check approved waived courses first, then ask whether you still need to manually adjust this semester's schedule. If results differ from your application, inquire using your application form and transcript; do not mistake application submission or preliminary review for complete approval.
向系辦確認自己這一屆要用哪份專題辦法，並一次詢問組隊、異動、審查與補審的表單。先: Confirm with the department office which capstone project regulations apply to your cohort, and ask for all forms regarding team formation, team changes, reviews, and makeup reviews at once. Check the version and target audience first; do not directly reuse files handed down from seniors.
把作品目前完成度與待辦清單給指導老師，詢問各次審查要展示哪些內容。再按當屆公告倒: Present your current work progress and to-do list to your advisor, asking what content must be presented at each review. Then schedule your production and document preparation backwards according to cohort announcements, leaving room for revisions rather than guessing deadlines on your own.
交件前請老師確認作品、說明文件、展演資料與授權是否都需要，並逐項對照指定格式。完: Before submission, have your advisor confirm whether the work, documentation, exhibition materials, and authorization forms are all required, checking item by item against designated formats. After submitting, verify receipt by the coordinator and whether supplementary files are needed; finishing the work does not mean official procedures are complete.
先找出入學分級結果及已修、抵免的英文與外語課，和自己的課表核對。若有免修，向通識: Retrieve your freshman English placement results as well as completed or waived English and foreign language courses, checking them against your curriculum. If granted a course waiver, confirm with the Center for General Education which foreign language credits still need to be made up; do not assume an exemption means credits are automatically fulfilled.
向通識中心說明入學年與目前成績，請協助找到語文承辦。報考檢定前先確認測驗、分數、: Explain your enrollment year and current grades to the Center for General Education to find the language program coordinator. Before registering for proficiency tests, verify acceptable tests, score thresholds, certificate validity periods, and alternative options; do not apply standards from other schools or scholarship programs.
把修課成績和語文承辦要求的證明分開整理，問清楚交件位置與認列方式。辦完再查畢業檢: Organize your course grades and the certificates required by the language coordinator separately, asking clearly where to submit them and how the submitted grades and certificates are recognized. Check your graduation audit afterward; if it still shows unpassed, bring your submission records to verify with the coordinator.
辦理前先聯絡系辦與註冊課務組，說明要休學或復學，以及自己的學籍情況。詢問導師或代: Before processing, contact the department office and the Registration and Curriculum Division to explain whether you plan to take a leave of absence or return to study, along with your enrollment status. Ask when your advisor or their designated deputy is available before scheduling your campus visit, avoiding being unable to find signing staff after picking up the form.
休學先備學生證；委託代辦時確認委託書，領表後按公告期限完成離校及繳件。復學則依本: For a leave of absence, prepare your student ID in advance; confirm power of attorney if delegating, and complete campus clearance and form submission within announced deadlines after collecting forms. For re-enrollment, follow the notice received and verify your contact information; never simply stop attending classes.
若是復學、轉入、轉系或延畢，主動向生輔組說明役男身分，確認需補哪些兵役文件。把學: If resuming studies, transferring in, changing majors, or extending your studies, proactively inform the Student Assistance Division of your draft-eligible status and verify required military service documents. Track student status changes and military service records separately; do not assume completing one settles both.
先向生輔組說明困難發生時間、目前最急的支出，以及已申請或已領的補助。請承辦協助判: First explain to the Student Assistance Section when the hardship occurred, your most urgent expenses, and any subsidies already applied for or received. Ask the coordinator to help assess applicable assistance plans; do not assume all aid is unavailable just because you missed one announcement.
依承辦指定方案準備申請表、在學證明與事件相關文件，例如醫療或失業證明。所得、財產: Prepare the application form, certificate of enrollment, and incident-related documents—such as medical or unemployment certificates—based on the coordinator's designated scheme. Ask clearly whether income, property, or household registration records are required and which version is needed before applying for them.
送件前確認由自己交件還是學校統一辦理，並問清楚本案期限與補件方式。再核對姓名及款: Before submitting, confirm whether you submit materials individually or the school processes them collectively, and clarify deadlines and methods for supplemental submissions. Check that your name and bank account details are correct; deadlines vary by program, so do not rely on dates from other notices.
先用自己能接受的方式告訴導師或校內承辦，目前是情緒、相處還是權益上的困難。若不知: First communicate to your advisor or campus staff in a way you feel comfortable with whether your current difficulty involves emotional distress, interpersonal issues, or student rights. If unsure whom to contact, ask them for a referral without needing to categorize the case type yourself beforehand.
到學校「在校學生」頁尋找線上預約諮商，依服務頁確認預約方式與可用時段。入口無法使: Visit the school's 'Current Students' page to look for online counseling appointments, confirming booking methods and available time slots on the service page. If the portal is unavailable or you do not know how to fill it out, ask your advisor to assist with contact; do not apply procedures from other universities.
把收到的通知、事情發生日期與想反映的問題整理好，先請承辦確認應走哪種程序。再問正: Organize received notifications, incident dates, and issues you wish to report, and first ask the coordinator which procedure should be followed. Then ask about official forms, submission methods, and deadlines; do not treat general student grievances and gender equality cases as the same matter.
先選出能代表能力的作品，註明自己負責的部分，並把作品連結實際點開檢查。履歷依想應: Select representative works showcasing your abilities, specify the parts you were responsible for, and test each work's link to ensure it opens. Tailor your resume to target positions without stuffing in every past assignment, making it easier for mentors to offer guidance.
帶作品與履歷向相關領域老師討論，再問職發中心目前有哪些職涯諮詢、職能檢測或徵才活: Take your portfolio and resume to consult teachers in relevant fields, then ask the Career Development Center about available career counseling, skills assessments, or recruitment events. Frame specific questions about unfamiliar job functions and skills rather than just asking if there are jobs available.
每個職缺都重新核對工作內容、應交資料與投件期限，再依公司指定方式送出。保留投件日: For each vacancy, recheck job responsibilities, required application materials, and submission deadlines before sending via the company's designated channel. Retain application dates and communication records; past recruitment posters serve only as reference and do not mean vacancies remain open.
先挑一兩件作品或專題，整理自己想繼續研究的問題，再找導師或專題老師討論。一起確認: First select one or two works or capstone projects and formulate the research topics you wish to pursue further, then consult your advisor or capstone advisor. Confirm suitable fields, preparation directions, and portfolio presentation methods together before looking for graduate programs based on your interests.
從報考學校官方入口下載當年度簡章，逐項看身分資格、所別書審與面試要求。本校應屆生: Download the current year's admissions brochure from the target university's official portal, checking eligibility criteria, graduate program document evaluations, and interview requirements line by line. Graduating students from our university must also verify brochure-specified certificates; do not share the same checklist across different universities and programs.
依簡章確認繳費期限與上傳格式，完成後檢查是否已確認送出，不是只把檔案放上去。再從: Verify payment deadlines and file upload formats according to the brochure; after completing, check that final submission is confirmed rather than simply uploading files. Track review statuses and notices through the official portal; different applicant categories may have different deadlines.
先問系辦與職發中心目前是否有公開甄選，再索取這一梯次的條件與表單。過去赴日實習新: First ask the department office and the Career Development Center whether open selections are currently held, then obtain requirements and forms for this cycle. Past news articles about internships in Japan only reflect past results and cannot be taken as evidence that openings or fixed subsidies still exist.
把國籍、學籍、語言與作品條件逐項對照甄選文件，另外問補助包含什麼、自己要付多少。: Check nationality, student status, language skills, and portfolio requirements item by item against selection documents, and inquire what subsidies cover and how much you must pay yourself. Being accepted into an internship does not equal receiving MOE XueHai subsidies; both funding amounts and eligibility must be verified via approved documentation.
錄取後先核對契約中的實習機構、期間與補助，再請承辦協助確認醫療、意外保險及合法實: After being admitted, verify the host institution, internship duration, and subsidies in the contract, then ask the coordinator for help confirming medical/accident insurance and a legal internship visa. Also clarify how pre-departure orientation, local contact channels, and post-return outcome submissions are handled.
向系辦說明想參訪的領域與可出國時間，問目前有沒有見學或短期移地教學。先拿到當期安: Explain to the department office your intended fields of visit and available travel dates, asking whether overseas study visits or short-term field study programs are currently available. Obtain the current schedule before making plans; do not assume past exhibition camps or exchange photos mean recruitment is active.
報名前把行程、自付費用、可能補助與取消條件問清楚；若想認列課程或實習，也先取得系: Before registering, inquire thoroughly about the itinerary, out-of-pocket costs, possible subsidies, and cancellation terms; if you wish to apply for course or internship credits, obtain prior confirmation from the department office. Overseas study visits and exchanges differ from workplace internships; credits cannot be granted simply because you travel abroad.
有當期公告後，再依主辦單位要求核對報名文件、護照、保險與入境準備。也確認帶隊或緊: Once the current announcement is published, verify application documents, passport, insurance, and entry preparations according to organizer requirements. Also confirm chaperones, emergency contact methods, and whether post-return outcome reports are required; do not directly reuse document checklists from overseas internships.
